name: ok-plugins
description: The ok-* suite: planning, code standards, and workspace hygiene plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: ok-planner
plugins.description: The ok-planner documentation corpus — concepts, provable stories and decisions, an issue queue — plus the sprint planning ceremony and corpus verbs (audit, prove)

plugins.name: ok-plumbline
plugins.description: Code standards for agentic maintenance — ships the Plumbline methodology: rules, lint binary, PostToolUse hook, and compliance skills

plugins.name: ok-workspaces
plugins.description: Workspace hygiene for parallel agent work — worktree-per-job, isolated runtime stacks, content-addressed artifacts — tailored to the project's declared stack profile

plugins.name: ok
plugins.description: The ok-* suite's front door — installs the suite as dependencies and provides /ok, the one-command update, bootstrap-by-consent, and true-up for every ok-plugin a project uses; knows the integration contract, never plugin internals
